cards.meaning: a formal statement or declaration — usually revealing something previously unconfirmed or only rumored
cards.example: Ang pahayag ng alkalde ang nagbunyag ng koneksyon na dati'y itinatanggi ng lahat.
cards.exampleMeaning: The mayor's statement was what revealed the connection everyone had previously denied.
cards.note: Distinct from 'komento' (a reaction or opinion about existing news) — 'pahayag' IS the new information itself, carrying real weight, especially when described as 'opisyal na pahayag' (an official statement).
cards.tiesTo: Baste Duterte's public admission on GenCorp's Davao City Hall contracts, called a 'confession of sins' by impeachment prosecutors

cards.meaning: reaching agreement or consent between two sides — the signal that two formerly differing positions are converging, short of the final signed document
cards.example: Malapit nang magkaroon ng pagsang-ayon ang Pilipinas at Canada matapos ang buwan-buwang negosasyon.
cards.exampleMeaning: The Philippines and Canada are close to reaching agreement after months of negotiation.
cards.note: Distinct from 'usapan' (an informal, still-unfinished conversation) — 'pagsang-ayon' is the signal that both sides are converging, not yet the final signed instrument itself.
cards.tiesTo: The Philippines-Canada free trade agreement reaching its final stretch after the 4th negotiating round in Toronto

cards.meaning: "mechanism" — an abstract noun for a structured process or system, common in policy and diplomacy writing
cards.example: 双方同意建立一个新的通知机制，以便在人工智能事件升级为国安问题之前及时沟通。
cards.examplePinyin: Shuāngfāng tóngyì jiànlì yí gè xīn de tōngzhī jīzhì, yǐbiàn zài réngōng zhìnéng shìjiàn shēngjí wéi guó'ān wèntí zhīqián jíshí gōutōng.
cards.exampleMeaning: Both sides agreed to establish a new notification mechanism, so that they can communicate in time before an AI incident escalates into a national-security issue.
cards.note: Register: 书面语 (formal, policy/diplomacy). Common collocations: 建立机制 ("establish a mechanism"), 通知机制 ("notification mechanism"). Distinct from 制度 (a formal institution or rule-system) — 机制 emphasizes the working process itself, not the institution around it.
cards.tiesTo: The Bessent-He Lifeng proposal for a bilateral US-China AI incident notification mechanism ahead of the Trump-Xi summit

cards.meaning: "so that / in order that" — an HSK-4 connective introducing the purpose or intended result of an action already stated
cards.example: 两国官员提前交换信息，以便在危机发生前采取行动。
cards.examplePinyin: Liǎng guó guānyuán tíqián jiāohuàn xìnxī, yǐbiàn zài wéijī fāshēng qián cǎiqǔ xíngdòng.
cards.exampleMeaning: Officials from both countries are exchanging information in advance, so that they can act before a crisis happens.
cards.note: Register: 书面语 (formal). Word order is action-then-purpose (action, 以便, purpose) — the reverse of 为了, which typically opens the sentence with the purpose before the action. Signals "in order to enable" rather than casual intent.
cards.tiesTo: The purpose clause behind the new US-China AI safety notification mechanism
